They are holding red envelopes and laughing. (2) The scene shifts to a bright white kitchen with a large island table. A middle-aged man in a white sweatshirt and black-and-white varsity-style jacket joins two women (one in red, one in blue) around the table. The table is covered with a grid paper and many blue-backed Mahjong tiles. (3) The group is actively playing a game where they pick tiles and place them on the grid. The man picks a tile with focus, while the women cheer and laugh. They are seen in medium shots and medium full shots. (4) A montage follows showing various close-ups of the grid being filled with Mahjong tiles and numbers being tallied. The woman in the red sweater shows high levels of excitement, clapping and raising her hands. (5) The final phase shows a celebratory moment where the women are jumping and cheering in a spacious living room area with a large TV screen in the background. The video ends with the two original women from the intro hugging warmly in front of the mountain backdrop, surrounded by dining table settings.

Voices shout out numbers like 'two thousand' and 'nine hundred' with high arousal and joyful laughter. Every time a tile is picked, a subtle 'ding' or percussive thud SFX is heard.
